workout.session_type: DAY A - Lower (squat emphasis) - FAT LOSS PHASE
workout.warmup: 10 min incline walk. Then 90/90 hip switches x 10/side, bodyweight glute bridge x 15, Cat-Cow x 10. RAMP THE SQUAT: 135 x 8, then 185 x 3. Write it down and do it - every session you ramp, you hit your numbers.
workout.coach_note: Day one of the fat loss phase, and I want to be straight with you about how this works, because the obvious version of it would cost you the thing you said you want to keep. You asked for workouts focused on optimal fat burn. The honest answer is that your workouts are not where fat loss happens. Four sessions a week burn maybe 1,600-2,000 calories. A 500-a-day change in what you eat is 3,500. Food is twice the lever and it is the more reliable one. If I turned your lifting into high-rep fat-burning circuits, you would burn maybe 150 more calories per session and you would lose strength - the exact trade you told me you do not want. So the heavy work stays heavy. Squat, deadlift, press, row: same loads, same reps, same full rest. That is what makes a calorie deficit cost you fat instead of muscle. What DOES change: your accessories now run as paired supersets with 45-60 seconds between pairs instead of 90 straight. Same volume, less time, higher heart rate. And the incline walk finisher stops being optional - in this phase it is part of the session. Two off-day cardio sessions, 35-45 min of easy Zone 2, and an 8-10k step floor. Then the real work, which is the kitchen: 140 g of protein is the number that matters most, alcohol is the first thing to cut, and I have had zero intake data since May 17. Last thing - skip the scale, I agree with you, but measure your waist at the navel once a week, mornings before eating. That plus your strength log tells us everything: waist dropping and lifts holding means it is working. Lifts falling means the deficit is too big and the fix is more food, not less training.
workout.finisher: 12-15 min incline walk. NOT optional this phase.

exercises.name: BLOCK 1 - Barbell Back Squat (SAFETY PINS MANDATORY)
exercises.note: Heavy stays heavy. Friday gave 225 x 4 then 205 x 6, 6 - the ask is 205 for 8. You train alone and you skipped the planned on-ramp to get here, so PINS SET BELOW DEPTH ON EVERY SET including the ramp. Brace before you unrack, chest up, controlled down, full depth, drive through midfoot. Clean 3x8 and we go to 215 next time, not back to 225 for singles.

exercises.name: BLOCK 1 - Hip Thrust Machine (RETEST)
exercises.note: You asked for this back and it runs on Day A from now on. 200 lb is a July number and you have not touched this machine in three months, so START AT 180 and find the real weight. Easy 12 at 180? Go 200 for sets 2 and 3 and report what landed. Full hip extension, hard glute squeeze, ribs down, chin tucked, no hyperextension at the top.

exercises.name: BLOCK 2 PAIR - Leg Extension + Seated Leg Curl
exercises.detail: Leg Extension 90 lb x 12, then straight into Seated Leg Curl 88 lb x 10. 3 rounds.
exercises.rest: 45-60 sec between ROUNDS only - no rest between the two movements
exercises.note: THIS IS THE FAT-LOSS ADJUSTMENT. Same sets and reps you would have done anyway, just paired back to back. Go extension straight into curl, then rest 45-60 sec and repeat. Your heart rate stays up and you save about ten minutes. Leg extension is the NEW home machine (90 was 10/10/10 Friday - chase 12s). Leg curl is your original machine where 88 gave 10 then 8 - ignore every leg curl number from the trip, those machines were calibrated differently.

exercises.name: BLOCK 2 - Walking Lunge (DB)
exercises.note: Progressing by reps, not load - own 30 for 12 per leg before we go to 35. DUMBBELLS OFF A RACK AT HIP HEIGHT, never hoisted off the floor. That rule does not expire. Torso tall, knee over the toe, drive through the front heel. Drop this one if the session passes 70 min - it is the lowest-value movement here.

exercises.name: BLOCK 3 - Core Circuit
exercises.detail: 2 rounds: Pallof Press 25 lb x 12/side, Hanging Knee Raise x 12, KB Plank Drag 30 lb x 20
exercises.note: Rotated fresh - not Friday's or Saturday's combination. Hanging knee raises are fine; you ran them Sep 14 and Sep 25 with no scapular issue. Hips square on the plank drag, do not let them rotate as you reach under.
